Lemma
[Uniqueness of Analytic Continuation] 1. ch12:12.1With $(M,g)$, $(\widetilde M,\widetilde g)$, and $\varphi $ as above, two analytic continuations of $\varphi $ along the same path $\gamma $ agree on a neighborhood of $\gamma (1)$ at time $1$.
Proof

\sketch Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of times at which the two continuations agree near $\gamma (t)$. It contains $0$ and is open by the local compatibility condition. If $t_i\in \mathcal T$ and $t_i\to t$, compatibility identifies both continuations near $\gamma (t_i)$ for all sufficiently large $i$. Their values and differentials therefore agree at $\gamma (t)$ by continuity, and the local uniqueness theorem for local isometries implies agreement near $\gamma (t)$. Thus $\mathcal T$ is also closed, so $\mathcal T=[0,1]$.

□
